aera: āēr, āēris (m.) — air, lower sky, mist (acc. sg., Greek form āera)

coram: coram (adv.) — face to face, in person, openly; (prep. + abl.) in the presence of

cum: cum — (conj.) when, since, although; (prep. + abl.) with

ducis: dux, ducis (m.) — leader, commander, founder (gen. sg.)

fessis: fessus, -a, -um — weary, worn out (m./f./n. dat./abl. pl.)
